text.tspan: HISTORIC VOLUME
@unhappychoice merges 76 PRs into lintric in a single week. Analysts baffled.
WEEKEND SURGE
@unhappychoice fires 261 commits on Sunday alone. Neighbors report suspicious keyboard sounds.
SURGICAL STRIKE
@unhappychoice fixes Norimaki OOM crisis with exactly ONE line changed. Heroes do exist.
NET NEGATIVE
@unhappychoice deletes 612 lines migrating tera 2.0. Codebase visibly relieved.
GOING PUBLIC
@unhappychoice ships gittype to Microsoft's winget registry. Windows users rejoice.
DEPENDABOT WHISPERER
@unhappychoice processes 90 reviews this week. All approvals. Zero mercy for stale deps.
TREE SURGERY
@unhappychoice manually untangles tree-sitter 0.25 across 25 files. Dependabot watches in shame.
POLYGLOT RAMPAGE
@unhappychoice touches Rust, TypeScript, Ruby, Kotlin and Gradle in the same week. Unhinged.
